senses.gloss: (b. h.; sec. r. of חזז, cmp. אחד)to press, seize, hold, keep; to befall.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 27b">Snh. 27ᵇ</cite> <he>אוֹחֲזִין מעשה וכ׳</he> holding in their hands the doing of their fathers, i.e. following their father’s example.
<cite ref="Bekhorot 33b:5">Bekh. 33ᵇ</cite> <he>אֲחָזוֹ דם</he> he had an attack of congestion.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 1:8:9">Y. Pes. I, 28ᵇ</cite> <he>אֲחוּזַת הדם</he> the animal attacked with congestion.
Y. Sabb. XIV, 14ᶜ bot. אֲחָזַתּוֹ עין a pain in the eye seized him. Ib. XIX, end, 17ᵇ אחזתו חמה fever overtook him; a. fr.—אָחַז בְּ־ to have a hold of.—
B. Mets. I, 1. Y. Yoma II, 39ᶜ top; a. fr.—Part. pass. אָחוּז holding fast, having a firm hold.

senses.gloss: א׳ את העינים to capture the eyesight, to delude by optical deception.
to be seized. Y. Taan. II, 65ᵈ top; a. e.
to distribute split wood (kindling chips) in the gaps of a large pile, to ignite with kindling wood.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 1:11">Sabb. I, 11</cite> (<cite ref="Shabbat 19b">19ᵇ</cite> sq.) <he>ומַאֲחִיזִין</he> ed. (Mss., Ar. a. Y.
<cite ref="Shabbat 19b">ib.</cite> beg. 4ᶜ <he>ומחזין</he>, ed. Ven. <he>ומחיזין</he>); v. <cite ref="H00525"><he>חָזָה</he></cite>.
